name: agent-skills
description: Claude Code skills, agents and hooks that take a ticket to a merged PR: ticket writing and delivery, Orca multi-session orchestration (program ledger, landing gate, dashboard), independent review, and retrospectives.

language.title: Response language
language.description: Value to propose for `language` in settings.json (e.g. English, Japanese, Korean). Leave empty to use the system locale.

checkout.title: Checkout path
checkout.description: Where setup-pc clones this repository so sessions read it live.

personal_repo.title: Personal config repository
personal_repo.description: URL of a private git repository holding your personal config. setup-pc clones it to ~/.config/agent-skills/personal and adds its agent-skills.json (personal keys such as tracker, notes and chat) and the tracker rules Markdown that tracker.rules_file points to into the settings diff. Existing values are never overwritten. Personal CLAUDE.md, skills, agents and autoMode rules are not carried over. Leave empty to skip this step; each feature then keeps its default (off, or asks on first use). Don't put a token in the URL; gh login provides access.
